༄༅/ /rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa tā ra nā tha'i dgung lo bzhi pa yan gyi rnam thar mdor bsdus zhig bzhugs/na mo gu ru/rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa che

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa tā ra nā tha'i dgung lo

bzhi pa yan gyi rnam thar mdor bsdus zhig bzhugs/ na mo gu ru/ rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa chen po/ khams gsum na ni 'gran zla dang bral ba/ mthong thos dran reg tu gyur pa'i 'gro ba rnams kyi ded dpon 'di nyid ni/ dang po lhums su gzhug pa dang*/ sku bltams pa'i ngo mtshar che ba rnams mtha' yas shing*/ brjod kyi mi lang bar gda' ste/ de la bdag rang rgyud che zhing*/ yul mi de skabs pa rnams dang*/ da lta'i rgyal rgyud byed pa rnams yid ches khungs btsun pa ltar yod cing*/ bcos ma ma yin pa nges shes 'drongs pa rnams yi ger bkod pa yin/༈ g.yon du brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi nang nas/ rdo rje g.yu sgron ma'i gnas/ kha rag 'brang gi phu dang po rwa lo tsā ba chen po/ de'i brgyud pa rim par byon pa'i bsti gnas/ da lta chos 'khor steng du grags pa na/ sngags kyi rdo rje 'dzin pa rje tshul khrims rgya mtsho la sras bzhi byung ba'i khab tu/ yum rdo rje bu dga' lha mo bzhes pas de ni dge ba la dkar zhing sdig pa la 'dzems pa/ ngan slong la byams pa zhig yod de/ yum dgung lo bcu dgu la/ rje btsun 'di nyid lhums su zhugs pa'i skabs/ yum gyi rmi lam du nyi ma'i 'od las/ gser gyi rdo rje gru gang ba 'od zer 'phro ba gcig babs te/ 'od zer des 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad khyab par gyur te/ yang 'od zer de rnams dang*/ gser gyi rdo rje dri ma med pa de/ yum gyi spyi bor thim nas yum sngar las kyang sku gzi mdangs dpag tu med pa rgyas pa dang*/ gzhan yang sku la dar sna tshogs pa'i na bza' dang*/ rin po che'i khri la bzhugs pa la/ bud med gzhon nu ma lang tsho rgyas pa/ 'ga' zhig gis/ rin po che'i snod du zas sna tshogs cung zad bzung nas phul ba dang*/ phyag dang skor ba/ bsti stang bsam las 'das pa byed pa dang*/ mi nag po gser gyi ske rags bcing pa/ lag tu gri gug bzung ba gcig gi sgo bsrung ba dang*/

lha'i bu dang bu mo mang pos nam mkha' nas sku khrus gsol zhing*/ mchod bstod byed pa dang*/ sku la rus pa'i rgyan dang*/ rin po che'i chas kyis brgyan pa la sogs pa'i rmi ltas bzang po ji snyed du ma byung ba rnams yum gyi mi rnams la 'di ltar rmi tshul bshad pas/ mi gzhan ma rnams kyis ni brjod ma shes par/ la las ni rmi lam de dga' rgyu med pas/ yum sku rims dang brtan bzhugs gang drag gy-is zer/ yid mi bde ba tsam byung*/ sngags 'chang chen po tshul khrims rgya mtsho zhes pa/ mdo sngags rig gnas thams cad la mkhas pa/ yi dam gyi lha dang chos skyong gi grangs bsnyen mang du song zhing*/ yi dam gyi zhal gzigs pa zhig yod pa/ de nyid kyi zhal nas/ bu dga' lha mo'i rmi lam de rnams shin tu bzang bar gda'/ deng sang bdag la yang rmi ltas bzang ba mang du byung bas/ bu dga' lha mo la gtsang sbra che bar gyis/ mi gang gi bza' bza' sogs spong*/ de nas rmi lam sogs kyang su gang la yang ma bshad gsungs nas/ yum la shin du brtse bar mdzad do/ /de nas phag lo hor zla dang po'i tshes bcu'i snga zhogs nyi ma rtse shar la/ yum snyel ba cher med pa'i ngang nas/ grod pu 'ja' tshon kha dog lnga ldan yod pa zhig 'khrungs so/ /mes po rin po che de nyid kyis zhal nas/ e e nged tsho la rigs rgyud 'di ltar yong ba yin/ 'di yi zhal 'byed par byed pa la/ lcags dang zangs kyi rigs kyi zhal 'byed mi rung 'di ni nges par du shing gi lde mig gis sgo 'byed tshul/ thags 'thag pa'i 'u lu zhig gis zhal 'byed pa sogs byed dgos gsungs nas/ 'u lu dang shing gi lde mig sogs kyis zhal phye bas de'i nang nas khye'u sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs dang ldan pa/ sku la sha mtshan khrag zhag gi thig le/ li khri'i tshangs skud kyi rnam pa yod pa/ phyag zhabs 'khor lo'i mtshan pa/ ga bur dang gur gum gyi dri mchog dang ldan pa/

padma rgyas pa'i mchu 'gros dang*/ utpal mchog gi spyan ni phyogs thams cad la hrig hrig gzigs shing*/ zhal nas oṃ sumbha ni sumbha ni hūṃ/ sogs kyi sngags lan gsum du mdzad pa zhig sku bltams so/ /lte ba gcod pa sogs ni ma dgos so/ /de skabs kyi sku 'khor ba rnams kyis 'di lta bu ni bzang ngan gang yin kyang 'di ni thams cad nas ya mtshan pa'i rang bzhin yin pa la/ skye ma thag tu lab lab shes pa zhig 'dug zer bas/ mes po drung gi zhal nas/ sha mtshan dang ltas shin du ngo mtshar che ba 'dug lab lab ni bsangs sbyangs kyi sngags mdzad par gda'/ dang po rje kun dga' seng ge de nyid kyi dgon pa 'dings pa mdzad dus/ sa dpyad dang rten 'brel gang la dpag kyang nged kyi mi brgyud kha cig nas rgyud sde thams cad kyi bdag po rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po gcig byon par gda' gsungs pa dang*/ 'di nyid yum gyi lhums su zhugs pa'i skabs rmi ltas bzang ba bsam las 'das pa yang byung ba dang*/ da nang gnyid ma sad gong du 'phags pa 'jam dpal yin zer ba'i/ skyes bu chen po mtshan dpes rab tu brgyan pa zhig gis/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab kyi po ti mang po/ deng rang gi mchod khang du spyan drangs nas 'di rnams kyi bdag po khyod rang yin gsungs shing*/ gsung rab de rnams la bu dga' lha mos bkur sti mchod pa bsam las 'das pa byed pa rmis/ 'di nyid rgyal ba'i gsung rab rnams la mkhas pa'i mi gcig yong bar 'dug /de ring gu ru rin po che'i dus bzang la byon pas 'di'i ming dar cig la sngar gyi chung sri zhig yod pas/ de gnod pa'i phyir dar cig la padma sri gcod rdo rje thogs shig /de bas mtshan dngos ni/ byang chub sems dpa' kun zin pa zhig gis gnang ba 'dug gsungs shing*/ shin du dge ba'i gsung gleng mang du mdzad/ btsas ston kyang de'i nyin shin du rgyas par mdzad do/ /de skabs me tog ldum rar rgya men lnga tsam kha byed cing*/

kha 'bus pa yang mang du byung*/ nye 'khor gyi se ba rnams la yang me tog thor re ba shar/ kham bu dang lo ma snang zhing 'deb kyi skabs dang 'dra ba byung*/ 'khur mang gi me tog kyang de'i nyin rang la mang du shar/ nam mkha' la me tog gi char zhag bdun khor yug tu babs pa dang*/ nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa'i ngang nas 'ja' 'od kyi gur khang bzhi rim/ nyin mtshan du yod pa dang*/ bya bye'u rnams kyang skad kyi rnam 'gyur snyan par sgrogs zhing*/ dga' spro rnam 'gyur dpag tu med pa byed pa dang*/ ri dwags rnams kyang dga' ba'i rtse 'khor byed cing*/ thams cad yul der 'khor nas yong ba dang*/ da ltar bla brang gi ldum ra na/ se ba gzhan las stobs che ba/ me tog rgya mtsho'i mdog ting phor tsam dang*/ se 'bru mi rgan gyi mtheb bong las che zhing*/ ro kha ba dang*/ skyur ba dang*/ nus pa tsha ba yod pa 'di yang de skabs su skyes pa yin par 'dug lags/ shing de yang gzhan las ngo mtshar che ba yod/ byang chub ljon shing gi mtshan nyid yod pa ni/ dang po sku bltams skabs myu gu skyes/ rab tu byung skabs me tog shar/ bsnyen par rdzogs skabs se 'bru smin/ da lta yal ga lo 'dab bsam las 'das shing*/ da lta'i mi drag zhan kun gyis se ba de'i 'bras bu me tog tsher ma shun pa rnams byin rlabs rten rdzas su zhus shing*/ thams cad ya mtshan du byed pa yod do/ /de nas mi nad phyugs nad mi 'byung zhing*/ mi rgan rnams ni tshe 'phel nas gzhan sha can du gyur pa dang*/ long ba rnams mig rang 'byed du gyur nas sngar las kyang gsal bar byung ba dang*/ mchog gi sprul sku'i 'di ni phyi nang gi mi kun gyi gces par gyur zhing*/ sku rdzi bzhi dang bcas nas bskyed bsrings so/ /sku lhums su zhugs pa dang*/ bltams pa'i rnam thar mdor bsdus pa'i le'u ste dang po'o// //༈ de nas zhag bcu tsam nas/ khams pa smri ti long ba yin zer ba'i/ long 'khrid byed dgos pa zhig byung*/

nga lha sa bsam yas bskor bar yong ba yin te/ 'dir byang chub sems dpa' chen po sa bcu'i dbang phyug chen po zhig byon pa/ nga tshos srin po rir shes nas 'dir 'ong ba yin/ khyed kyi sras mjal dgos zer bas sku gces pas mjal kha ma gnang bas/ khong rnams bla brang la phyag 'tshal bskor ba byas smon lam mang du btab nas log song ngo*/ / zhal ngo yum sku 'khor rnams la kha ngan gtong zhing ma mgu bar gyur nas song ngo*/ /de skabs yul mi la las mo lan gnyis btab 'dug kyang*/ mo snga phyi tshang ma shin du bden par 'byung zhing*/ mngon shes dang ldan zhing dpyad pa kun la nyams rgyus che zhing ming 'dogs shes pa zhig byung*/ mo btab pa thams cad du de rnams la khyed bsod nams che/ byang chub sems dpa' sku bltams pas gnas chu btung bas ngan song myong mi dgos pa yin pa la/ khyed kyi yul du byang chub sems dpa' bltams pa yin pas bsod nams che/ 'dis ni sems can gyi don dpag tu med par mdzad de/ rtsang dbus kyi sde dpon bsod nams che ba rnams kyi bkur sti zhu bar gda'/ 'di la 'brel ba don ldan rang yin zer/ de rnams yum la mi rnams kyi 'di bzhin zer ba 'dug zhus pas mes po drung gi zhal nas/ de ya mtshan par gda'/ dang po bdag gi bla ma dbus smyon mjal skabs su/ bla ma de rten 'brel dang*/ mngon shes rang mdzad pa zhig gda' bas/ bdag la yang khyod la tsha bo sus kyang 'gran mi nus pa'i mthu rtsal shin tu che ba zhig 'byon gsungs pa na/ bdag gis bsam pa la rwa lo tsā ba'i brgyud pa la sngags 'chang bzang po los yong bsam pa byung tshe/ de yang bla mas mkhyen nas/ de ni khyod kyi pha mes rigs rgyud thams cad las lhag par 'gyur gsungs/ 'o na ci lta bu zhig 'byung zhus pas/ de ni byang chub sems dpa' skad gnyis smra ba/ rdo rje'i glu len pa/ snyigs ma'i ston pa zhig 'byon par 'dug gsungs yod pa dang*/

de rnams mthun par gda' gsungs so/ /de nas mchog gi sprul sku de ni gzhan gyi zla bskyed las/ khong gi zhag bskyed che ba tsam byung*/ zla ba brgyad nas thams cad la 'byon thub pa zhig byung*/ zla ba bcu gnyis nas smra brjod mkhyen zhing shin tu nas kyang sgom pa dang dbang po rab tu dwangs zhing klog klog pa dang 'bri ba dang*/ yi dam chos skyong gi mngon rtogs rtsa sngags/ gtor chog rnams ni sus kyang slob pa'i rnam pa dang*/ dka' spyad gcig kyang ma dgos par rang shes su mkhyen pa dang*/ sngar gyi bris rnying gi thang sku gshin rje dgra nag gdong drug 'char ka'i tshe bdag khams gsum rnam rgyal la sogs pa'i bris thang du bas nag pa mang po yod pas/ sngar gyi yab mes rnams kyi thugs dam thang sku yin pas/ mos pa tsam byas nas bzhag pa ma gtogs/ de dag lha gang yin dang*/ rigs gang yin su la yang rgyus med pa la/ mchog gi sprul skus ni thang sku de rnams zhal phye nas/ re re nas 'di lha 'di rnams yin pa gsungs nas de thams cad re re nas ngo mkhyen pa dang mes po drung gis mtshan padma sri gcod rdo rje phul ba yin kyang*/ mi rnams kyi mtshan mgyogs bcos su byas nas/ dbon po sri gcod zhes pa byung bas/ mtshan nas bos pa'i tshe/ de la mi dgyes pa'i tshul mdzad nas/ nga'i ming ni bla ma 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo dpal ldan kun dga' grol mchog zer ba yin/ dbon po srid gcod su la zer ba yin/ nga la de skad ma zer zhig gsungs nas/ mtshan nas bos pa la mi mnyes zhing gsungs lan kyang mi mdzad pa byung*/ de skabs kyi mi rnams kyis bla ma kun dga' grol mchog bya ba'i/ bla ma'i mtshan ni sngar thos ma myong zer nas ya mtshan du gyur to/ /de nas mi rnams kyi dri ba zhus pas/ de rnams la thogs pa med par sku tshe sngon gyi gnas tshul dang*/ sbyin bdag grwa rigs dgon gnas/ phyag rdzas kyi skor dbang rdzas/

rten rdzas la sogs pa gang na ci yod pa rnams dang*/ nye gnas dpal 'byor gyi phyag phyi zhus nas sna dkar rtser phebs pa dang*/ sde pa bstan 'dzin pas tshogs 'khor rgya chen po zhus pa dang*/ de nas rong rin dpungs phyogs ni mun pa nag por 'dug pa dang*/ 'bring gi kha ni 'od gsal che bar 'dug pas/ der nged gnyis kyi yong nas/ la khar sna dkar rtse'i 'khyos ma zos/ lhag ma rnams de khar spungs nas bzhag yod/ de nas la babs nas 'ong ba'i tshe/ yum gyi ba phyugs la chu blud nas zur kha rgyab nas phar byon song ba na/ bdag rgyug nas yum gyi na bza' la 'jug nas yong ba yin/ nye gnas dpal 'byor grong pha gi la song ba yin/ gsungs nas phyag mdzub kyi ston pa sogs mdzad pa dang*/ bdag gi nye gnas gzhan ma/ drung kun chos pa dang mched grogs bzhung ma dang*/ pha ba la sogs pa'i grwa pa rnams dang*/ rta drel rnams chos lung byang rtse na da lta yod gsungs pa sogs dris lan gsung gleng zhib par gnang bas/ spyir rigs ni phu rags pa'i mi mthong ba dang myong ba chung ba kun gyi chos lugs yin zhing*/ khyad par 'brang phu'i mi rnams ni phu rag gi mi dang*/ phu rag gi chu'i dper song nas/ go shes chung ba dang ma bcos pa'i bya ba lhug grol du gnas pa/ rdzi sang dang*/ rnam dpyod kyi dri mas ma gos pa med pa phu gong la dang*/ mda' them pa la byed pa'i dpe ltar mthong myong shin tu chung ba ni 'bring gi mi rnams kyi chos lugs yin pas/ gsung gleng de dag rnams thos ma myong ba 'di ya re mtshar/ 'di lab lab mang lugs dang*/ sku skyed yod stangs gang la dpag na/ lha'i bu chen po gcig yin pa 'dra 'di nang gi phug tu gzhug la/ phyi la ma gtong zer nas/ nang rang du sbas thabs kyi sgo nas skyed bsrings so/ /de nas nam zhig 'tshogs pa dge 'dun sgang pa'i chos bzhi 'brang sna bzhi ru nas gnyer ba bzhi yod pa'i nang nas/ dpal gnas chos bya ba zhig gis khams cung zad mi bde ba'i khong gnyis 'brang phur sman zhu ba dang*/

rtsa dang chu spyan lam 'bebs par byung bas de skabs mes po rin po che dang*/ a khu lags kyi sman dpyad la mnga' shin tu brnyes pas/ khong jo gdan pa gnyis nang du bos nas gzhi len rgyas par mdzad pa dang*/ sman sogs gnang nas yod skabs mchog gi sprul sku ni rgyun du mi kun la chos kyi che ba dang*/ las rgyu 'bras/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal/ dal 'byor rnyed dka'i chos dang*/ gzhan yang dbang rjes gnang sogs gnang gin yod pa de khong gnyis kyi mthong bas khong gnyis ni ya mtshan du gyur nas phyag 'tshal zhing byin rlabs zhus/ 'di ni rje btsun bla ma kun dga' grol mchog pa'i sku'i skye ba gsal bar 'dug /'di dbus gtsang gi sde dpon chos sde gnad che ba'i bla ma yin/ nged dge 'dun sgang pa rnams bla ma de la mi phyed pa'i dad pa yod/ bla ma de ka'i nged 'tshogs pa rnams la gsung chos mang du gnang ba yin/ nged gnyis pos kyang gsung chos mang du thob zer nas yab yum rnams la rje gong ma'i lo rgyus mang du zhus/ 'di'i bla ma 'di gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i nged rang tsho bsod nams che zer nas song ngo*/ khong gnyis kyi rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog gi lo rgyus bshad du byung ba ma gtogs su gang gi kyang mi shes/ de nas yab phun tshogs rnam rgyal bya ba*/ yi dam gshin rje gshed mtha' dag dang*/ bka' brgyad skor dang*/ phyag rdor rnams la 'dris shing*/ khyad par du ma ning la grangs bsnyen mang du song zhing*/ ma ning gi zhal yang yang gzigs pa nus mthu che ba/ mdor na drag sngags kyi rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po yin pa la/ 'jig rten gyi bya ba mkhyen pa ma bcos pa'i khul dog pa/ bu dung che ba zhig yod pas/ de'i gsung nas/ nga'i bu gcig po 'di dpral ba'i mig dang 'dra ba/ 'di bla ma'i sku skye yin pa 'dug su gang gi zer ba byung na sku rgyab la gtor sgam rlang pa thul le ba zhig yod pa ngas mi rgyag na dkon mchog gsum/

nga'i bu gcig po 'di nged rang gi rgyud pa gser gyi 'phreng ba lta bu 'di zin pa/ chos rje kun dga' seng ge'i rdo rje gdan 'di dang sbyin bdag kha shas 'di rnams skyong dgos pa yin gsungs nas/ thams cad la gsang nas bzhugs/ de nas zhag kha shas zhig nas nam zhig zhal ngo 'khor dang bcas pa rnams nang du gsol ba gcig gnang skabs yang lung nas yin zer ba'i rnal 'byor pa sku sha sngo sang nge ba sku la ras dang stag lpags kyi na bza' gsol zhing*/ mi thod rlon pa lag tu bzung ba ral pa'i thod bcing pa zhig sgo 'byed pa dang khyi bkag pa sogs ma dgos par nang du thal le byung bas/ tshang ma shin tu 'jigs shing skrags pa zhig byung ba la/ mchog gi sprul sku ni shin tu dges par mdzad cing*/ rnal 'byor pa des kyang mchog gi sprul sku la phyag 'tshal zhing thal mo sbyar nas sngar 'dris pa bzhin gsung gleng mang du mdzad cing*/ gsung gleng de rnams kho rang dpon slob gnyis shin tu smra bar gda'/ zhal ngo 'khor bcas rnams kyi tshig 'bru gcig kyang ma go /de nas rnal 'byor pa de nyid kyis mchog gi sprul sku nyid la/ rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi khrus chog cig phul/ lcags kyi phur bu gru gang ba zhig phul nas phur bu 'di slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyis/ ye shes mtsho rgyal la gnang de nas sna nam rdo rje bdud 'jom gyi bsam yas su gter la gzhug ste/ ye shes mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis lung bstan nas bla ma g.yung ston pas gter nas bton dgra bgegs lan gsum bsgral nas ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro rnams kyi phyag tu yun ring du bzhugs pa yin/ 'di ni bgegs dang log 'dren gyis mi tshugs pa'i phyir sku la 'chang bar zhus nas phul/ de nas yum drung gis chang legs shig zhus pas rten 'brel legs gsungs nas/ mi thod rlon pa sha tshal gyis bkang nas nang mchod byin rlabs mdzad nas/ mchod pa spro bar gsol nas theg song ngo*/

/rnal 'byor pa de ni sgo phyi la thon pa dang mi mngon par gyur/ sgo thon nas mi sus kyang mthong tshod su la ma byung bar nga'i 'dir yang sprul pa'i rnal 'byor pa zhig yin 'dug phur bu de yang mchog gi sprul sku la bsrungs ba'i tshul du phyis mkhan chen lung rig rgya mtsho yi spyan 'dren la zhus kyi bar du sku la bcings/ de nas phur bu de 'brang phu dgon par bzhugs pa ni da lta mchod khang gi nang rten khrod na bzhugs pa 'di yin no/ /gang ltar yang mchog gi sprul sku 'di nyid ni/ ngan long la byams shing*/ mi thams cad la kho rang rnams dang 'dra ba'i sgo nas gang la gang 'tshams kyi chos dang*/ sangs rgya ba'i gdams ngag rang ston pa dang*/ byis pa rnams la byis pa rang dang mthun pa'i chos ston pa dang*/ mi rgan rnams la mi rgan rang dang mthun pa'i chos ston pa/ mi thams cad la rang rang dang mthun pa'i bslab bya dang chos 'brel gnang ba zhig byung*/ sems can byol song rnams la snying rje chen po'i sgo nas byin rlabs dang srog las skyob pa mang du mdzad/ bzo dang gso ba rig pa la sogs pa'i rig gnas kyang mtha' dag la mnga' brnyes pa byung*/ mchog gi sprul sku de mi kun gyis ya mtshan du gyur pa'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //na mo gu ru/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po/ rig kun gyi bdag po mthong thos dran reg rnams kyi ded dpon/ rje btsun rdo rje 'chang thams cad mkhyen pa chen po/ sgrol ba'i mgon po de ni/ dgung lo gsum dang zla ba phyed drug bzhes pa'i skabs nyin zhig nyi ma snga phyed tsam la/ chos rje bstan 'dzin pa'i bang chen yin zer ba'i grwa pa gnyis byung ste/ 'di na nged dpon slob kyi bla ma dam pa'i sku skye 'khrungs yod 'dug zer bas/ de yin min la gzigs par chos rje bstan 'dzin phebs kyin yod/ de kha'i khyed zhal ngo gang du'ang mi theg pa zhu zer ba'i sngon 'gros zhig byung*/

mchog gi sprul sku'i zhal nas nga ngos 'dzin pa'i skal ba kho la med de/ thog mar bstan 'dzin nyi ma bzang po bya ba kho bo la rten 'brel bzang bas shar re bdag gi rtsar thong zhig gsungs/ de nas nyi ma snga phyed tsam la dgon gnas mthong bar rgya gling dang dung dkar gtong gin byung bas/ de yang rten 'brel legs gsungs/ de nas khong dpon slob rnams bla brang du phebs nas/ kho rang la bzhugs khri che ba zhig byas mchog gi sprul sku la kho rang gi g.yas su sa gdan dang bcas pa'i bzhugs khri zhig gi steng du bzhugs phyag 'tshal ba ni ma byas/ ja yang kho rang sngon du gsol/ de nas chos rje bstan 'dzin pas mchog gi sprul sku la dri ba sogs gang sa nas zhus rung*/ mchog gi sprul sku'i nged bla ma yin/ kho nged kyi gra rigs su gyur pa tsam ni yin/ de las spros pa min pa la kho rang kham che rgyu byed pa ni/ dga' mo min pa 'dug dgongs nas mi mnyes pa'i tshul mdzad nas bka' lung chen po mi gnang bas yang chos rje bstan 'dzin pas sgam chung zhig na tsan dan dmar po'i ḍā ma ru gcig bstan nas 'di khyed kyi ngo i shes/ 'di gang yin pa gda' zhus pas/ mchog gi sprul sku'i zhal nas de ngo los shes/ dang po nged rang gi yin pa la/ khyed kyi byang stag rtser bde mchog dus 'khor 'jigs byed sogs kyi dbang zhus rten 'brel dang byin rlabs yin pas bdag la bla chas 'os rigs dgos tshul nan gyi byung bas de dus nged kyi bla chas zhig sbyin pa'i tsandan gyi ḍā ma ru de yin pa 'dug gsungs pas/ de gcig po yid ches nas phyag 'tshal/ dar ras kyi 'bul ba dgu tshan gcig phul yab yum la dar ras kyi lnga tshan zhig phul nas/ khyed kyi sngon chad gtsang sbra thon pa byung 'dug da rung gtsang sbras thon pa dang*/ skas kha sogs la sku babs ma byung ba mdzad dgos 'di nged kyi bla ma yin da lta spyan 'dren snga nas yod pa 'dug

/bdag kha rag gi rdzong du rab gnas zhig la zhag kha cig sdod de nas chu bo ri dang*/ gong dkar phyogs la 'gro de tsho ru zla ba kha re sdod dgos shas che/ de nas slar sku drung rin po che yong ngo gsungs nas theg song ngo*/ /de ma thag tu yab drung pa ni shin tu mi mnyes pas/ nga'i bu chung lha phrug 'dra ba 'di la khong ma ṇi bar song bas/ za 'dod langs pa zhig yin nam gsungs nas 'bul ba dar dkar gcig gzan legs po gcig ras yug dkar yol snam dkar bub gcig rnams khur nas khong gi rjes la song nas/ chos rje bstan 'dzin pa phyis byon khar yab drung gi chos rje bstan 'dzin pa la 'bul ba mdzad nas/ nged rwa lo tsā ba rdo rje grags kyi rgyud pa gser gyi 'phreng ba lta bu zam ma 'chad pa ni/ dgon gnas thabs shes zung du 'brel ba 'di sngags kyi bstan pa 'dzin zhing*/ dad pa dam tshig dang ldan pa'i sbyin bdag rgya che bar yod pas 'di rnams skyong dgongs pa yod pas da lta nged rgas khog sha ba'i rwa lcau 'dra ba zhig la rgyud 'dzin dpral ba'i mig ltar gces pa lta bu 'di ka yin/ gcig po 'di gong du zhu ba bzhin mi gnang ba zhu/ bu chung gcig po de ni 'di khar dgos pa yod pas khyed kyi bla ma'i sku skye min pa'i 'phrog mi gnang ba zhu/ de'i zhu rten du 'bul ba 'di rnams mdzod gsungs pas chos rje bstan 'dzin pa'i gsungs nas khyed de 'dra mi gsungs ba zhu/ khyed kyi rgyud 'dzin da rung los yong sku gzhon par gda' ba da lta 'di ni rje bla ma dam pa'i sku skye gsal ba yid ches pa rang gda' 'di nyid rang tsho sku skyes min bya ba zer dgos med/ khyed rang zhal ngo rnams kyang phun sum tshogs par yong*/ 'brang ba zhes pa'i phu 'di tsam zhig khyed yab yum gyi phyag tu bla ma dam pa'i sprul sku spyan 'dren pa'i blu yon du 'bul rgyu yod pa da lam bdag gi kha rag tu zhag mal zhig bsdad nas 'phral du gong dkar du phyin nas bla ma dam pa'i sprul sku spyan 'dren pa dang*/

blu yon mi zer 'di rnams kyi rgyu mtshan 'bul du 'gro dar cig la khyed rang gi thugs 'dod kyang yin lags dgos pa zhig 'dug pas bla ma dam pa'i sku skye yin pa phyi nang thams cad du gsang ba zhu nged rnams kyis kyang gsang ngo*/ /phugs su bla ma'i sku skye min bya ba gsang ba nged rang kun gyi mi thub/ dar cig nged rang tshang mas gsang gsungs nas yab kyi phyag nas bcang bcang mang du mdzad nas thegs song ngo*/ /de bzhin kha rag rdzong du yang*/ khong rdzong dpon rnams kyis kyang sku skye nges shes 'drong mi 'drong gi dri ba mdzad 'dug pas/ yab drung dang gsungs chad mdzad pa ltar/ da lam bdag gis lam zhor la 'dug pa dang*/ rna thos la yang gsung chos dang dbang rjes gnang sogs bslab mi dgos par/ rang shes su 'dug zer ba'i snyan grags byung ba nas/ tshur lam zhig bltas pa yin kyang*/ de skyes bu chen po gzhan rang min pa 'dug gsungs nas thams cad la gsang nas bzhugs 'dug de kha'i dbus phyogs kyi sde dpon rnams dang*/ grwa rigs kun the tshom byas nas ngos 'dzin che 'don 'gyangs pa zhig byung*/ de'i ngang nas yun ring ba na/ mkhan chen lung rig rgya mtsho ngos 'dzin spyan 'dren zhu song zer ba kun la grags pas chos rje bstan 'dzin pa ni zhal skyengs pa/ spre'u shing 'bras gzhan gleng dpe ltar byung*/ khong zhal skyengs pa chen po byung ba'i stabs kyi/ de rje bla ma dam pa'i sku skye min no zhes pa'i gleng gzhi chen po bcug go /chos rje bstan 'dzin pa'i ngos 'dzin dang mjal dka' zhus pa'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// //༈ na mo gu ru/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po lung rig rgya mtsho de nyid dpal 'khor chos sde chen po'i bla brang dkar po na bzhugs pa'i skabs/ stag lo hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i cho ga gcig mdzad pa'i nub mo rmi lam du rje de nyid dang mjal zhing*/

dges pa'i 'dzum zhal dpag tu med pa dang gsung gleng dngos su mjal ba ltar gyi dga' ba dpag tu med pa mdzad pa byung*/ tho rangs khar bud med rgyan gos mdzes pa la sogs mang po nam mkha' la dgyes pa'i gar bsam las 'das pa byed cing thams cad kyis kyang mgrin gcig tu dpal nag po spyod pa 'gro ba sems can gyi don la byon pa de ni/ lha'i yul gyi bye brag dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma'i 'du sa rgya bod kyi mkhas grub du ma'i brten pa'i gnas kha rag 'brang gi phu nas byon yod pa lung rig rgya mtsho zhes/ rna 'on po mtshan ldan bla ma'i drung du myur ba nyid du gshegs par 'tshal/ zhes mgrin gcig tu zer ro/ /de ma thag tu mnal yang sangs bar byung ba dang*/ nam langs 'dug sku lus sngar dang mi 'dra ba'i bde ba chen pos gang ba dang*/ thugs dga' spro brjod mi shes pa zhig byung bas bdag gi bla ma de'i sprul sku de nyid cig byon yod pa thag chod 'dug /mdang rmi lam du byung ba'i bud med de rnams mkha' 'gro ma'i lung bstan pa zhig yin par gda' dgongs nas thugs dam grol ba dang*/ sngar dang mi 'dra ba'i sku bde tshor byed cing*/ rab gsal du phebs pa dang*/ nyi ma shar ba dang gsol dpon gyi ja khyer ba dang*/ sde pa sna dkar rtse bas bang chen zhu shog rten dang bcas pa 'byor ba mnyam du byung bas/ sna dkar rtse ba'i zhu shog la gzigs pas/ 'brang phu na rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog gi sku skye yid ches shing gsal ba nges shes 'drongs pa zhig 'dug pa sogs kyi rgyas bshad du 'dug pa khong bang chen gnyis kyang sku gzhogs su btang nas 'brang phu'i dri ba gnang nas/ khong gnyis kyi 'brang phu'i gnas tshul rnams zhus pas/ de dang po mkhan chen rang la zhal gdams dang*/ yul bkod pa shog khra zhig gnang ba dang mthun byung bas mkhan chen ni char 'dod bye'u 'brug sgra bzhin dga' ba brjod kyi mi lang ba ba spu g.yo ba bzhin du byung zhing mkhan chen gyi gsungs nas mdang rmi lam du yang bdag gi bla ma dang mjal ba yang rmis/

da nang rten 'brel sogs gang gi sa nas shin tu legs/ sde pa bstan 'dzin pa zhes pa'i ming bkra yang legs pa 'di dag dang*/ bdag gi bla ma'i lung bstan mdzad pa rten 'brel sogs 'di lta bu'i legs gsung shin tu dgyes par gyur/ de'i nyin rang rtsang byang gi grwa rigs sbyin bdag che gra rnams mi sna bskul ba'i pho nya bar btang*/ de dag rnams nas kyang mchog gi sprul sku spyan 'dren la mi sna rta pa lnga drug re dang*/ yab yum la 'bul ba dang bcas so so nas byung mkhan chen dpon slob dbu mdzad pa'i rtsang byang gi grwa rigs sde dpon so so'i mi sna dang bcas pa'i rta pa brgyad cu rtsa lnga tsam rang rang so so'i yo byad dang*/ 'khor bu rta mang po dang bcas nas hor zla dgu ba'i yar tshes bzang po be'u spel gyi 'grub sbyor la rgyal dkar rtse'i dpal 'khor bde chen nas 'brang gi phu la mchog gi sprul sku spyan 'dren par chas/ sna dkar rtser zhag gcig mal zhig mdzad/ 'brang phur snga mgyogs su rta pa gnyis btang nas de'i nub yar gzigs su bzhugs/ khong snga mgyogs pa rnams kyang 'brang phur byon mkhan chen dpon slob rnams mchog gi sprul sku spyan 'dren du phebs kyin yod nged tshor snyan 'bul zhu ru yong ba yin/ de lam khong dpon slob shin tu rags bsdus mang po yod/ do nub yar gzigs su pheb rgyu yin/ sang nyin snga mor phebs yong*/ de ka'i gra bshom gnang dgos zer bas/ yab yum rnams ma mnyes shing*/ khong dpon slob mang po zhig 'ong nas nged kyi bu chung 'phrog rtsis i yin/ khong rta hrag mi hrag byas kyang nga'i bu chung ci la 'phrog rgyu yin pa khyed gnyis po yang song 'di tshor ma sdod cig /'phral du log pa dga' 'bang gi bu 'phrog pa byung na 'di las dgra che ba med khong rang dpon slob rnams kyang nged sngags pa'i dgra 'di mi dga' nged la chos skyong ri dwags la sha khyi las sbung rbad sla ba mthu glog dmar las myur ba zhig yod/

su gang yang brnyes pa ma byed cig zer khong rnams la khrims gtam mang du bsgyur nas/ da lta song zer zhing gos gong ba nas bzung ste phyir phud do/ /lung pa'i mi rnams kyang bla brang pa'i sras 'di 'khrungs nas yul 'di bkra shis pa byung*/ 'di ni phyir 'gro ru mi 'jug /'di phyogs gzhan la song na yul 'di ci 'dra zhig yong mi shes zer zhing sdug bsngal bar gyur/ yab yum rnams shin tu yid mug par gyur te/ mchog gi sprul sku ni shin tu mnyes pas/ lung rig pa nga'i grwa pa dam tshig dang ldan pa smon lam dang 'brel ba zhig yin pas 'di nga yi rtsar phebs su chug khong snga mgyogs pa 'di gnyis yang nang du khrid la lto sbyin zhig /yab yum rnams kyang de bzhin du sdug bsngal bar ma mdzad cig /bdag kyang bdag rang gi dgon pa dang grwa rigs rnams dang*/ dad ldan gyi 'gro ba sems can gyi don du chos zab mo zhig byas nas/ rgyal khams thams cad la 'gro ba sems can gyi don du nyi zla ltar 'gro 'o gsungs nas/ yab yum rnams kyi thugs gsol shing*/ spro sems gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i sgo nas zhal brda mdzad cing*/ khong snga mgyogs pa rnams la zhu lan rgyas par gnang*/ sang mkhan chen lung rig pa la bsu chang gy-is shig gsungs so/ /sang nyin de 'brang la ru phebs pa'i tshe mi lam rgyus shes pa rnams kyi 'brang phu zer ba 'di yin no/ /zer nas mdzub mo btsugs pas mkhan chen gyi phyag na sngon rje btsun gong ma'i zhal gdams phyag dpe shog khra sogs gnang 'dug pa dang i mthun zhal phye nas legs par gzigs pas/ 'di gnyis ni thig btab pa dang 'dra'o gsungs nas 'brang gi phyogs la phyag 'tshal bar mdzad nas thugs dgyes par 'gyur zhing*/ dang po bla ma de nyid kyi bdag la shog khra gnang ba de ni yul 'di'i khog shar gyi ri maṇḍal ltar yod pa/ byang ri nag po gnam du langs pa 'dra ba/ nub gangs dkar po rgyal blon gyi tshul du yod pa/

me tog padma kha phye ba 'dra ba/ rtsa ba chab gnas/ yul gyi chu bo thams cad dbus su 'bab pa/ ri klung thams cad sman ljongs dri zhim pos gang ba/ bya ri dwags sna tshogs pas mdzes shing*/ shing tsher ma can gyi nags tshal/ rgyab ri dar dkar gyi yol ba 'dra zhing*/ mdun ri dpa' bo chas su zhugs pa bzhin gnas gzhi bya ngang pa'i sgo nga 'dra ba zhig tu 'byon par mdzad pa yin/ shog khra zhal gdams gnyis ka nas 'di shin tu gsal bar gda'/ 'di lta bu thams cad mkhyen pa chen po 'jig rten gyi khams na da lta zhal gsung thos pa 'di 'o cag tsho bsod nams che/ bskal pa bzang po yin/ na ning nas lha bdag po'i sku skye chu shel ba de nas spyan drangs zer ba de yang*/ yul 'di dang 'dra se ba 'dug pas bdag gis bla ma de khong rnams kyis bla ma'i ngos 'dzin byas pa min nam bsam sems ma bde ba 'byung zhing*/ bla ma la gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ nub gcig nam mkha' la bdag gi bla ma'i chos skyong yin zer ba'i mi nag po rta nag la bzhon pa lag na mdung dar nam mkha' gang ba zhig klad la bskor zhing*/ ha ha'i gad mo 'brug sgra ltar sgrogs pa/ nam mkha' la me dang glog dmar rab tu 'khyug pa zhig nyi ma dbus kyis phyogs nas mtshan ldan bla ma'i sprul sku bltams nas zhag kha cig song ngo*/ /nged skyed bsring pa'i bar chad srungs bar 'gro ba yin zer zhing sa dang bar snang thams cad g.yo ba zhig byung bas bla ma de dang mjal ba 'dug bsam nas blo bde ba zhig byung*/ khyad par nyi ma de ring nas mi bdag gi bsam don thams cad 'grub bo gsungs zhing dgyes pa'i rnam 'gyur mang po dang bcas te/ la babs nas phebs la dmangs kyi da la lta la snang spang 'bor grags pa'i mdun du phebs pa'i tshe chos 'khor sdings gzigs pas shog khra na yod pa'i bkod pa dang*/ spu tsam gyi 'khrul pa mi 'dug /'di ltar gsal ba yod pa 'di thams cad mkhyen pa'i gzigs pa chen po yin pa 'dug

/de ltar na kho bo yang byang chub sems dpa' chen po zhig yin par gda' gsungs zhing zhal 'dzum mul gyi shor nas chibs bshol nas chos 'khor sdings la phyag mang du mdzad/ thal mo sbyar zhabs pus mo sa la btsugs ste maṇḍal rgyas pa zhig dang yan lag bdun pa lan gsum mdzad/ de nas chos 'khor sdings thug gi bar zhabs thang la phebs pa yin zhing*/ bkra shis brag tu phebs pa'i tshe bla brang nas bsu chang chang brdzi'u shin tu che ba lnga ja stibs rgyugs byung bas/ mkhan chen gyis gsung nas/ phyi nang gi rten 'brel shin tu legs/ da ser 'phreng dang*/ rol mo sogs gyis gsungs nas/ dung chen cha gnyis dang dung dkar cha gcig rgya gling cha gcig /mkhar rnga la sogs pa'i rol mo mang po'i sgra dang bcas chos 'khor sdings su phebs so/ /bzhugs gnas g.yul sa chen po ru/ gur dkar po bsam las 'das pa la/ yol gor phyi nang mang po dang*/ bla re gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang*/ ba dan dag dar lcog bsam las 'das pa ni/ lha'i yul rnam par rgyal ba'i zhing khams ltar longs spyod mnga' thang brjod kyi mi lang ba byung ngo*/ /rje btsun mchog gi sprul sku dang*/ chos rje mkhan chen gnyis ni gcig gi gcig la 'jus shing*/ dgyes pa'i gsung gleng zab mo 'chad cing*/ bzhugs khri chen po rgya dpangs mtho ba re la bzhugs so/ /chos rje mkhan chen gyi rje btsun sprul sku la phyag 'tshal gser zho nyi shu rtsa lnga/ gos dar sogs kyi dgu tshan gnyis phul/ de skabs me tog gi char bab cing*/ 'ja' dkar po gur phub pa sogs byung*/ de nas zhag po drug nas/ mkhan chen dpon slob rnams gong dkar sogs la zhag po bdun phebs nas/ mchog gi sprul sku rtsang phyogs la spyan 'dren gyi dgongs ba zhu bar thegs/ de skabs 'brang phu gong dkar ba'i bdag rkyen mdzad skabs lags/ yar phebs dus la nang dkar mo bya ba'i zhing khar gur phub nas der zhag po bdun bzhugs pa gnang*/

mchog gi sprul sku yang nyin re bzhin gur khang du phebs/ gur du phebs dus nam mkha' nas me tog gi char dang*/ 'ja' 'od dkar po dang*/ sil snyan dang*/ dung dang*/ pi waṃ dang*/ rnga chung rnams kyi skad snyan pa bsam las 'das pa nyin re bzhin byung*/ de dus yab yum rnams la gser zho lnga brgya/ rta pho ser po gcig byi ru spos shel bad bu gang*/ zangs lcags gos dar/ ras la sogs pa'i dgu tshan bcu gcig 'bul ba mdzad de/ sna dkar rtse nas sde pa bstan 'dzin pas/ sku rdzi ba gcig rta 'dzam gling rdo mgyogs zer ba'i rta gcig rta rdzi dang bcas pa mchog gi sprul sku la phul/ yab yum rnams la gser zho bzhi/ khro gcig ras dar gyi dgu tshan gcig /sa cha them skang nyi shu'i bka' bzhes dang bcas gnang*/ zla ba bcu pa'i tshes bzhi la rtsang phyogs la chibs kha bsgyur ba yin zhing*/ yul gyi mi mang po dang*/ yab yum gyi bkra shis brag mdo thug gi bar phebs skyel la phebs/ bkra shis brag la yi ge rang byon sngar gcig las med pa la de'i nyin mchog gi sprul sku'i phyag gis reg pa rnams la da lta yang yi ge gsal bar yod/ 'di yang 'khor lo sdom pa'i snying po ni yin/ bya bye'u dang ri dwags rnams kyang skyo ba'i rnam 'gyur dang*/ phebs skyel gyi rnam par byung*/ yul gyi mi rnams ni thams cad mkhyen pa la lta zhing*/ 'o dod chen po 'don te/ la la smon lam bzang po 'debs la la ni bdag lta bu sems can skal ba med pa rnams la thugs rjes gzigs shig zer zhing lus sa la rdeb/ la la ni nged yul mi rnams da ci 'dra zhig yong zer gdong mchi mas gang zhing smre sngags 'don pa byung*/ yul mi phal cher ba la thugs phyir 'brangs de thub bya ri dwags rnams kyis kyang phebs skyel la yong*/ dus de nas lo bcu gcig bar du/ mchog gi sprul sku'i 'byon skabs bzhin/ mi la shi chad med pa dang*/ lo phyugs dang 'bras bu rgyas shing/

bya ri dwags rnams kyang gong du 'phel/ mdor na yul de yang khyad par du 'phags pa byung*/ da lta yang mi rnams kyi gtam rgyud gleng zhing thams cad la rgyus yod pa mang po yod/ lhag par bdag kyang shin tu nges par yi ger bris pa yin/ de nas mchog gi sprul sku dpon slob shin tu mang ba dang bcas/ yar 'brog sna dkar rtser phebs sde pa bstan 'dzin pa la sogs pa'i dpon g.yog rnams la bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang*/ spyan ras gzigs kyis sgom lung gcig gnang bas/ tshang ma kun gyi ha las shing*/ chung chung nas rnam spyod dang spobs pa 'di lta bu zer zhing*/ dad pa chen po gus pas 'dud do/ /de nas zhag bco lnga nas rgyal rtser phebs/ thugs sras lha dbang grags pa dang rin po che rdo ring pa dang*/ rje kun dga' dpal bzang la sogs pa'i grwa rigs mang po dang mjal/ rgyal rtse bdag po zhal ngo rnams kyi yun ring du zhabs tog bsam las 'das pa zhus/ de nas thams cad la sngar gyi dri ba dang gsung gleng rje de tsho dang dngos su mjal ba ltar mdzad/ de nas sgra dang rtsis tshad ma rnam 'grel la sogs pa'i mdo'i phyogs la sbyang pa mdzad/ bla ma yang rje brag stod pa dang*/ rdo rje ring pa dang*/ ye shes dbang po dang*/ kun dga' bkra shis dang*/ rje byams pa lhun grub dang*/ rje lung rig rgya mtsho la sogs pa'i bla ma mang du bsten nas/ mdo rgyud thams cad la mkhas shing sku'i yon tan dang*/ mdzad pa 'phrin las gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas pa ni/ sa thog gi lha 'dre mi gsum tshang ma la rgyus yod pa de yin par 'dug /che brjod mi dgos shing rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa rang gi mdzad pa'i phyi nang gsang gsum gyi rnam thar rgyas bshad du 'dug pas 'dir ma bkod/ 'di ni dgung lo bzhi pa yan gyi rnam thar gsal zhing nor 'khrul gtan nas med pa zhig yin/ 'dis rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che la phan zhing 'gro ba sems can la phan bde rgya chen por gyur cig

/ces rje btsun bla ma'i rnam thar chung ngu 'di/ /snyan ngag sdeb sbyor la sogs pa mi shes pas/ /'di la gzigs po rnams kyis bzod par gsol cig /dgung lo bzhi pa yan rgyus che ba'i snyan ngag sdeb sbyor med kyang*/ ku su li'i yi ger bkod pa yin/ 'di ni skye yul ma ga dhā dang dbyer med pa'i 'phags yul 'brang phu dang da lta gnas nges med byed pa/ mtshan ldan bla ma'i ming gnang ba'i tshe bstan dar rgyas rdo rje pha mas ming btags pa tsitta zhes par gyur pa/ yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen la gnas pa bdag gi 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi bsgrub gnas chen por yos lo hor zla lnga par bris so// //bkra shis shog /sarba maṅga laṃ/ dge'o/ /
